01 · About

A bit about me

I'm a B.Com graduate from Shanmuga Industrial Arts Science College (affiliated with Thiruvalluvar University, 2025), originally from Thiruvannamalai and now based in Chennai. Somewhere along the way, spreadsheets stopped being a chore and started being interesting — that curiosity is what pulled me into data analytics.

Today I work with SQL, Python, and Power BI to turn complex, messy data into insight a business can actually act on. I'm just as comfortable cleaning a dataset as I am presenting the story it tells. Alongside the technical side, I bring strong stakeholder coordination, people management, teamwork, and multitasking skills.

Outside of work, I'm usually exploring new places, at the gym, or reading up on whatever's new in tech. Long term, my goal is to grow into an analyst who pairs technical depth with strategic thinking.
